description:
Re-extract voice blocks from the active script WITHOUT touching assets
    or their reference images — the non-destructive alternative to scan_script
    after a script edit. Blocks whose spoken text is unchanged keep their
    audio; only edited blocks come back empty, so a follow-up
    generate_voiceover fills just the gaps. Synchronous and free — the split
    is deterministic. Returns {block_count}.
